verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a sandbox test environment, Basic-Auth API keys (App ID/Secret), and OpenAPI-based codegen for Java/Python/Node client libraries, which cover much of the technical integration path. However, there is no evidence of a self-serve signup flow to obtain API keys, no dedicated 'quickstart' tutorial, and a probe found the claimed OpenAPI spec file returning 404 at all standard paths, undermining the client-library generation claim. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup/API key creation, a runnable quickstart guide, and a verifiable/working OpenAPI spec link for client-library generation.
